mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 49 degrees with light drizzle near the Verona Area High School, and we are currently experiencing a New Moon phase.

Election season is underway as candidate packets are now available for the 2027 Spring Election. Additionally, residents should be aware that a public meeting is scheduled for December 8 at the Senior Center regarding the Military Ridge State Trail paving project.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today we have live music at Paddy Mac, yoga at Insight Wellness, and a pizza and pitcher special at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, tomorrow features trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
In a notable call from October 25, officers responded to a situation where a driver was arrested for an O W I after being located at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor is the decadent Chocolate Caramel Twist. Our doors are open and we are serving until 10:00 PM tonight, so stop by soon to grab your favorite treat.
